{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Whaddya see out there, Mac? A zillion acres of grain crop, that's what. We can't eat it, but the native bovines can, an' we can eat them.|Inspector Bernie, to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>}}
'''Bovine''' was a type of creature that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dilonexa XXIII]]. The bovine there [[Diet/Legends|fed]] upon the local [[Grain/Legends|grain]], which was [[Foodstuff/Legends|inedible]] to the local [[Dilonexican]]s.<ref name="LCFO" />
